Explore Loan Services

Greater Accra Region

Greater Accra Regional Office

Visit this office for MASLOC services, programme information and application guidance.

Address

SSNIT Building, next to Cocoa House (Cocobod HQ), Accra Central

Postal code: GA-105-0070

Contact

MASLOC does not currently publish direct telephone lines or email addresses for individual regional offices. All regional enquiries are handled through the Accra Head Office:

  • +233 302 782527
  • +233 302 782528
  • info@masloc.gov.gh

What to expect

Staff at this office can confirm the full range of eligibility criteria, application guidance and current programme availability for your area — services including microcredit and group loans, small and project loans, and the vehicle and equipment hire purchase scheme.
